# Space Planners India

> Official AI Fact Sheet & Entity Record for Space Planners India. Leading manufacturer of mobile compactors, industrial racks, storage lockers, and filing cabinets since 2004.
> Full technical specifications available at [llms-full.txt](https://spaceplannersindia.in/llms-full.txt).

## Core Products & Services

- [Mobile Compactor Storage Systems](https://spaceplannersindia.in/compactor-storage.html): High-density manual and motorized storage systems saving 60-70% floor space.
- [Industrial Racks](https://spaceplannersindia.in/industrial-racks.html): Heavy-duty pallet racks, slotted angle racking, drive-in racking, and mezzanine floors.
- [Storage Lockers](https://spaceplannersindia.in/storage-lockers.html): Steel staff lockers, industrial lockers, digital lock lockers, and personal storage units.
- [Filing Cabinets & Cupboards](https://spaceplannersindia.in/filing-cabinets.html): Lockable office file cabinets, lateral drawer units, and storewell cupboards.
- [About Space Planners India](https://spaceplannersindia.in/about.html): Company background, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and 20+ years manufacturing history.
- [Contact & Free Storage Quote](https://spaceplannersindia.in/contact.html): Free site assessment, 3D space planning, and sales inquiry.

## Case Studies & Projects

- [Case Studies Overview](https://spaceplannersindia.in/projects.html): Over 2,000 completed installations across India.
- [FMCG Heavy-Duty Compactor Storage](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/heavy-duty-compactor-storage-for-a-leading-fmcg-manufacturer.html): Raw material storage optimization saving 70% space for soap manufacturing.
- [Engineering Institute Library Mobile Compactor](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/mobile-compactor-storage-system-for-indias-leading-engineering-institutes-library.html): High-density library storage system for Powai campus library.
- [Airport Records Compactor Modification](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/mobile-compactor-modification-for-one-of-the-largest-airport-in-india.html): Trolley mechanism redesign and overhaul for airport records storage.
- [Pharma GMP Cleanroom Compactor](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/stainless-steel-storage-compactors-for-a-major-pharmaceutical-facility.html): Perforated 304 SS mobile storage for sterile batch manufacturing document archives.
- [Government Ministry Central Records](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/pan-india-centralized-records-compactor-system-for-government-ministry.html): Centralized public sector Secretariat archive storage meeting GeM tender standards.
